description: The message and every string value are cut to CAPTURE_CHARS (17408) characters before redaction, with max_message_chars 0 (no per-value truncation). msg and b: a Bearer token straddling the cut is redacted against the cut text, so the ' tail' after it, past the cut, is gone. a: the space at character 17407 is inside the cut and stays; 'tail' after it is past the cut. c: an sk- key whose run reaches the cut is redacted whatever its length, since it may go on past the cut, so the five characters the cut leaves of it are redacted too (docs/contract.md, Values: the capture limit).

lines: level=INFO logger=teleclaude.core msg="Bearer <REDACTED>" a="Bearer <REDACTED> " b="Bearer <REDACTED>" c="Bearer <REDACTED> sk-<REDACTED>"
